title: Telemetry Recovery 1
solution: Localize o evento backup com codec zlib+base64; decodifique Base64 e descomprima zlib.

title: Cipher Relay 1
solution: Aplique XOR com a chave periódica em hexadecimal indicada nas notas.

title: SQLite Incident 1
solution: Consulte a tabela audit e filtre event=recovery e status=quarantined.

title: Packet Reconstruction 1
solution: Abra capture.pcap no Wireshark, extraia payloads UDP, ordene FS-SEQ e concatene DATA.

title: Firmware Carving 1
solution: Procure o marcador FSRECOVERY\x00; leia 2 bytes little-endian de tamanho e depois a flag.

title: Source Audit 1
solution: Inspecione app.js, identifique diagnostic e decodifique Base64 (atob).

title: Log Timeline 1
solution: Filtre source=collector, confira integrity SHA-256 prefixo de 8 caracteres, ordene seq e concatene part.

title: Archive Forensics 1
solution: Liste os arquivos ocultos do TAR e extraia archive/.recovery/session.token.

title: Binary Endianness 1
solution: Converta cada palavra hexadecimal em quatro bytes little-endian; remova NUL finais.

title: Multi-Stage Encoding 1
solution: Base64 decode, zlib decompress, reverse bytes.
